name: training_serving_feature_contract
description: Formal contract mapping training dataset features to real-time production features and serving semantics

features.production_source: Go API request: req.Amount (converted from minor units / cents to float)
features.training_semantics: Transaction amount in base currency units
features.production_semantics: Transaction amount in base currency units

features.training_source: Chronological rolling window: COUNT(events WHERE ip == IP AND t >= T - 3600 AND t <= T)
features.production_source: Redis Sorted Set: ZCOUNT vel:ip:{tenant}:{ip} [now-1h, now]
features.training_semantics: Number of transactions observed from client IP in preceding 1 hour
features.production_semantics: Number of transactions observed from client IP in preceding 1 hour

features.training_source: Chronological rolling window: COUNT(events WHERE ip == IP AND t >= T - 86400 AND t <= T)
features.production_source: Redis Sorted Set: ZCOUNT vel:ip24:{tenant}:{ip} [now-24h, now] (or 4x 1h approximation)
features.training_semantics: Number of transactions observed from client IP in preceding 24 hours
features.production_semantics: Number of transactions observed from client IP in preceding 24 hours

features.training_source: Chronological rolling window: COUNT(events WHERE card == Card AND t >= T - 86400 AND t <= T)
features.production_source: Redis Sorted Set: ZCOUNT vel:tok:{tenant}:{token} [now-24h, now]
features.training_semantics: Number of transactions observed for payment instrument token in preceding 24 hours
features.production_semantics: Number of transactions observed for payment instrument token in preceding 24 hours

features.training_source: Stateful lookup: 1 if DeviceID observed with User prior to time T, else 0
features.production_source: Inferred from 1 - req.IsNewDevice (or device registry lookup)
features.training_semantics: Whether device fingerprint has prior history with the account at time T
features.production_semantics: Whether device fingerprint is recognized for this user

features.production_source: Mapped from payment / merchant type in payload (default 0 for standard e-commerce)
Derived from payment_method.type or token prefix ('tok_visa' -> 0, 'tok_mastercard' -> 1)
Derived from BIN lookup or payment method metadata (default 0)

features.training_source: Historical risk dictionary computed strictly on train split: high risk for disposable domains
features.production_source: Heuristic risk mapping table in Python ML service
Binary indicator: 1 if address distance not provided else 0
Extracted from client User-Agent or device metadata in payload
Binary indicator: 1 if device_fingerprint is empty else 0

features.training_source: TransactionAmt / trailing_mean(TransactionAmt | card) strictly up to time T
features.production_source: Online feature store historical mean lookup or default 1.0
features.training_semantics: Relative transaction deviation from cardholder historical mean
features.production_semantics: Relative transaction deviation from cardholder historical mean
